scripts.check:ci: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check-schema && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run build
scripts.check:push: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check-schema && pnpm run check-api && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:race && pnpm run check-web && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run build && pnpm run test:web-e2e
scripts.format: node tools/build/src/format-go.ts && oxfmt package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml orval.config.ts .agents/plugins .claude-plugin deploy docs/openapi.yaml .github/workflows packages/cli/package.json packages/web packages/plugin-codex packages/plugin-claude packages/plugin-pi packages/plugin-opencode tools/build
scripts.format:check: node tools/build/src/format-go.ts --check && oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml orval.config.ts .agents/plugins .claude-plugin deploy docs/openapi.yaml .github/workflows packages/cli/package.json packages/web packages/plugin-codex packages/plugin-claude packages/plugin-pi packages/plugin-opencode tools/build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run lint && oxlint orval.config.ts packages/web packages/plugin-pi packages/plugin-opencode tools/build
scripts.generate:api:go: cd packages/cli && go tool oapi-codegen -config internal/server/api/oapi-codegen.yaml ../../docs/openapi.yaml
scripts.generate:api: pnpm run generate:api:go && pnpm run generate:api:web
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/web run build && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run sync:web
scripts.check-web: pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/web run build && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run check:web
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:web && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run build
scripts.dev:data: pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run build && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run setup-dev-data
scripts.dev:cli: pnpm run dev:data && TOKENINSIGHTS_ACCESS_TOKEN= ./packages/cli/bin/tokeninsights tui --mode single-process --sync=false --all-time --collector-db-path .tokeninsights-dev/collector.sqlite --server-db-path .tokeninsights-dev/server.sqlite --app-db-path .tokeninsights-dev/app.sqlite --server-url ""
scripts.install:cli: pnpm run build:web && cd packages/cli && go install ./cmd/tokeninsights ./cmd/tokeninsights-server
scripts.build: pnpm run check-schema && pnpm run check-api && pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:plugins
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck:plugins && pnpm run check:plugins && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run typecheck && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run test && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/web run test && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run test
